description: Accessibility improvements for WhatsApp Desktop on Windows. Keeps NVDA on the message field while typing, reads what is under the mouse, and adds commands to move to the chat list, the message list and the message field.
changelog: On a message, the Applications key and Shift+F10 open the menu of that message, with the focus on its first item. A message menu that opens without the focus on an item gets it on its first item, the reactions bar no longer takes the focus from the menu, and one Escape closes the menu and returns to the message.
